description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_default' that compiles the 'default' modifier for Smarty templates. The function provides a default value for variables that are empty or unset during template rendering.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_default
methods.description: Compiles the 'default' modifier in Smarty templates to assign default values to empty variables during template processing.
